Everything below is about weights, valuation,      split multipliers and who may move what -- none of which cares which      venue the trade goes through. The venue is the one hole: `_swapVia`.      BasketAdapter fills it with Uniswap v4 (Robinhood Chain) and      BnbBasketAdapter with PancakeSwap v3 (BNB Chain), because those two      are shaped differently enough that one cannot be configured into the      other -- v4 is a singleton you unlock, v3 is a pool per pair that calls      you back. acknowledgeMultiplier(address).details: The stock tokens schedule multiplier changes and apply them by      timestamp, so one can take effect with no transaction of ours.      `balanceOf` is unchanged by it while `balanceOfUI` moves, and which      of the two the price feed refers to is not something to guess at      with a share price downstream. So valuation halts on any change and      an operator has to look before it resumes.

isValuable().details: Lets a caller check before attempting something that would revert.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

removeConstituent(address).details: Refuses while a balance remains, so a position cannot be orphaned      into an adapter that no longer counts it.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

sendSliceToVault(uint256,uint256).details: In-kind exit needs no price, so it deliberately does not consult      the oracle. It keeps working when feeds are stale and when the      equity market is shut, which is exactly when it matters most.

params.shareDen: Denominator of the fraction being redeemed.
params.shareNum: Numerator of the fraction being redeemed.

sendToVault(address,uint256).details: The vault is the only possible destination, and it is immutable.

sweepStableToVault().details: Covers a `buy` that spent less than was sent over.

totalValueUsd().details: Reverts if any price is stale or any split multiplier has moved.      A basket that cannot be valued honestly must not be valued at all —      the number feeds a share price.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

acknowledgeMultiplier(address).notice: Accept a new split multiplier and resume valuing this token.

buy(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Spend stablecoin already sitting here on `token`.

holdings().notice: Raw balance held of each constituent, in the same order as `tokens`.

isValuable().notice: True when every constituent can be priced right now.

sell(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Sell `amountIn` of `token` and forward the proceeds to the vault.

sendSliceToVault(uint256,uint256).notice: Send a pro-rata slice of every holding to the vault.

sendToVault(address,uint256).notice: Send part of a holding to the vault, for in-kind redemption.

stable().notice: The vault's underlying asset, the other side of every swap.

sweepStableToVault().notice: Return stablecoin held here to the vault.

totalValueUsd().notice: USD value of everything held, scaled to 1e18.

valueOf(address).notice: USD value of one holding, scaled to 1e18.

vault().notice: The only address assets may be sent to.
